name: Red Hat 2026
notes: Extracted from 6 SVG exports of the official Red Hat standard presentation template. Key changes vs. default: vertical accent rules on all content slides, triangle bullets, icon-only footer logo (requires logo-icon.png asset), title indented to clear the accent rule, both agenda columns shifted to right half of slide. Cover slide uses white bg + red title text + left photo panel — requires a new addCoverSlide() helper; cover layout values are in coverSlide below for reference.

coverSlide.description: White background, left photo panel, red title text on right — not white-on-red like addSectionDivider
coverSlide.darkStripNote: Near-black vertical strip spanning full slide height, drawn behind the photo panel. Visible ~0.86" wide at the far-left edge before the panel image starts.
coverSlide.panelAssetNote: Red Hat fedora on black, portrait 1125×2048 — same file used for both cover and closing

closingSlide.description: Same left photo panel and wordmark logo as cover. Right area has speaker contact info + 2×2 social icon grid. Bottom rule only.
